edges.reason: Constructor writes owner state variable.
Constructor reads msg.sender to set owner.
owner is set from the caller-controlled msg.sender.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner access-control check.
newOwner parameter flows into the owner state variable.
finishDistribution sets distributionFinished to true.
finishDistribution is guarded by onlyOwner.
distr increments totalDistributed.
distr credits balances[_to].
distr performs SafeMath add on totalDistributed and balances.
distr uses the _to parameter as balance key.
distr uses the _amount parameter in arithmetic.
doAirdrop credits balances[_participant].
doAirdrop increments totalDistributed.
doAirdrop may set distributionFinished when totalDistributed >= totalSupply.
doAirdrop performs SafeMath add operations.
_participant parameter selects the credited balance slot.
_amount parameter is added to balances and totalDistributed.
adminClaimAirdropMultiple calls doAirdrop in a loop.
adminClaimAirdropMultiple is guarded by onlyOwner.
_addresses array supplies the loop targets.
_amount parameter is forwarded to doAirdrop.
loop index i bounds the iteration over _addresses.
Fallback function delegates to getTokens.
getTokens conditionally calls distr.
getTokens reads totalDistributed for the finish check.
getTokens can set distributionFinished to true.
getTokens initialises the local tokens variable.
getTokens assigns msg.sender to the local investor variable.
getTokens derives investor from msg.sender.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates balances of sender and recipient.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] for the debit.
transfer performs SafeMath sub and add on balances.
_to parameter is the credit target of transfer.
_amount parameter is the moved value in transfer.
transferFrom mutates balances of _from and _to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom checks allowance against msg.sender as spender.
transferFrom performs SafeMath sub and add operations.
_from parameter is debited in transferFrom.
_to parameter is credited in transferFrom.
_amount parameter is moved in transferFrom.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
_spender parameter keys the allowance mapping.
_value parameter is stored as the allowance.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
getTokenBalance performs an external balanceOf call on a caller-supplied token.
withdrawAltcoinTokens reads the external token balance.
withdrawAltcoinTokens invokes an external token.transfer that could re-enter before state settles.
withdrawAltcoinTokens is guarded by onlyOwner.
local amount holds the external balance used in the transfer.
External token.transfer sends the withdrawn amount to owner.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against owner.
